stories.text: Bred at Guisachan in the Scottish Highlands; top of the French LOF (a little over 15,000 births, as reported) and of Dogs Australia (3,776 registrations in 2025).
Developed in Britain from Newfoundland water dogs; the Royal Kennel Club still registered 29,919 in 2025.
Filed by the FCI under France; 69,342 registered with the Japan Kennel Club in 2025, most of them toy poodles.
A Mexican breed; 46,221 JKC registrations in 2025.
